range_decision.evidence: A clear temporary offset appears in the E and U components between indices 620 and 634: at index 619, E = -11.80844, U = 0.6256; then a jump to E ≈ -10.376 at index 620, followed by sustained elevated E (~-10 to -11.9) and U (~0.3 to -0.5) until index 634; at index 635, E drops sharply to -5.48472 and U to -0.69819, indicating a return. N shows no matching step, but the superposition across E/U confirms a platform-like offset. No permanent step coincides exactly; the offset is isolated and reversible over ~15 samples. Another candidate (indices 670–675) involves large N/E/U jumps but lacks a clean opposing return—instead it merges into ongoing motion, so excluded. Only one robust temporary offset interval identified.
